Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner first misinterpreted the question by assuming “the team that Pa Amadou Gai is a member of” referred to his club (ASC HLM in Dakar) and thus concluded the country was Senegal, instead of recognizing the likely intended meaning as his national team (The Gambia). This misinterpretation steered subsequent steps toward the wrong answer despite later evidence and acknowledgment of the national-team interpretation.
